_about: Outdoor space seen on a visit, per school building. A visit beats every other source (app/utils/outdoor_space.py). One entry per building: the school id, words its register address contains, the visit date, and what was seen in both languages. Photos and notes: docs/OUTDOOR_SPACE.md.

text_i18n.bg: Училището е в офис сграда. Ползва малка площадка с катерушки в градината на бизнес парка, малко футболно игрище с изкуствена трева и поляна до него.
text_i18n.en: The school is in an office building. It uses a small play area with climbing frames in the business park's garden, and a small artificial-turf football pitch with a field next to it.
